title: Home guide: the pinhole camera
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y8 lesson 23 (Home practical guide and safety card: pinhole camera (portal worksheet; never look at the Sun))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Make a model of the eye and see an image form.
equipment: A pin (an adult makes the hole)
safety: NEVER look at the Sun, with or without the camera
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Cut a square window in one end of the box and cover it with foil.
Cut out the other end and cover it with tracing paper (the screen).
An adult makes a pinhole in the middle of the foil.
Point the pinhole at a bright window (not the Sun) and look at the screen.
Is the image upside down? Compare the parts with the eye: pinhole = pupil, screen = retina.
